title: Breast Feeding Tracker Privacy Policy
htmlContent:
Breast Feeding Tracker is designed to support parents with simple feeding logs while respecting privacy.

Data Collection

This app is intended to minimize data collection. Feeding entries and related tracking details are stored locally on your device.

How Data Is Used

Tracked information is used only to provide timeline history, summaries, and in-app insights for you.

Sharing and Tracking

Breast Feeding Tracker does not sell your data. It is not designed for advertising profiling or cross-app tracking.

Your Choices

You can remove your tracking data by deleting entries in the app or uninstalling the app, depending on feature availability.

Contact

If you have any questions, contact support@scruffyhipster.com.
